anomaly_types.definition: Single telemetry reading exceeding physical or operational threshold outside allowable noise margin
Reading normal in isolation but abnormal given external context (e.g. high motor current at zero flow)
Sequence of values individually plausible but collectively indicating systematic degradation
Monotonic upward or downward drift exceeding expected seasonal or process ramp rate
Unusually rapid acceleration in temperature, vibration or differential pressure
Discrepancy between redundant or physically coupled sensor channels (e.g. FT-101 vs FT-210)
Simultaneous emergence of subtle abnormalities across equipment, human workload and utilities
Operator bypass or manual setpoint bump without documented operational rationale
Abnormal compression of turnaround schedule coincident with budget freeze and deferred PMs
